clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Sparks Political Debate And Personal Revelations
aiSummaryBullets: The memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love provides insights into historical political moments, including the 1969 Presidential elections and the 1999 Congress revolt.
Personal anecdotes in the book range from Sonia Gandhi's 1978 visit to Indira Gandhi in Tihar Jail to her reflections on interactions with Pranab Mukherjee.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Very Poor To Severe Categories
aiSummaryBullets: Most monitoring stations in Delhi continue to record air quality levels classified as very poor or severe.
Specific locations including IIT-Delhi have reported air quality index readings exceeding 400.

clusters.headline: India Joins Global Coalition To Secure Artificial Intelligence Supply
aiSummaryBullets: India joined a ten-nation coalition led by the United States to secure artificial intelligence supply chains against competition from China.
The European Union imposed anti-dumping duties on steel exports arriving from India and four other nations.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Comments On Internal Security And Ideologies
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi accused ideological supporters of Naxalism of infiltrating political and social organizations.
The Prime Minister observed 'Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas' in memory of Birsa Munda and stated tribal communities suffered under previous administrations.

clusters.headline: Security Operation In Kulgam Follows Recent Attack On Security Forces
aiSummaryBullets: Security forces engaged in a counter-terror operation in Kulgam, resulting in the death of an alleged militant.
The operation follows an attack on Central Reserve Police Force personnel that occurred on November 11.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Criticizes Lack Of Progress In Yamuna Cleaning Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court observed that the Yamuna River's health remains poor despite significant financial allocations for cleaning.
Judges linked the river's condition to systemic failures in municipal administration across cities, towns, and villages along its banks.

clusters.headline: Political Debate Erupts Over Yamuna River Status During Chhath Puja
aiSummaryBullets: Political parties in Delhi have exchanged criticisms over the condition of the Yamuna River during the Chhath Puja festival.
BJP officials participated in Usha Arghya rituals along the riverbanks, praising the quality of arrangements made for the event.

clusters.headline: India Secures Under-19 Asia Cup Title Amidst On-Field Controversy
aiSummaryBullets: India secured a narrow one-wicket victory against Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final while chasing 337 runs.
Aaryavir Sehwag finished the tournament as the leading scorer after his match-winning performance in the final.

clusters.headline: Prince William And Princess Catherine Arrive In Mumbai For Earthshot
aiSummaryBullets: Prince William and Princess Catherine have begun a three-day official visit to India starting in Mumbai.
The couple is scheduled to attend the sixth annual Earthshot Prize ceremony, which recognizes climate change innovation.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Grants Bail To Two Convicts In Bilkis Bano Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India has officially suspended the life sentences of two men convicted in the Bilkis Bano case.
Court documents note that the individuals have been incarcerated for more than 17 years prior to this decision.
